# theme.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown theme.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: themes/NAME.toml beside head.toml, chosen by head.toml `theme = "NAME"`

a head palette: one `role = "look"` line per role. Read by rano::theme; a bad line is reported and skipped

## `top level`

A look is words: fg:N / bg:N (N 0-15, #rrggbb, or cube:0-255), bold, dim, italic, underline, reverse; or plain. head.toml color.ROLE applies on top.
